gui.guhs.bouwopdracht.klaar: The %1$s family is done: %2$s! Come and see.
gui.guhs.bouwopdracht.transport.start: The kangaroo gets going: hop hop, from chest to chest!
gui.guhs.bouwopdracht.sjouwen.start: The elephant starts carrying for the Bouwkeet!
gui.guhs.bouwopdracht.bank_gekoppeld: Bank Guh linked: the family also takes its blocks from the bank.
gui.guhs.bouwopdracht.wijs.een: Close the menu and click the spot for the job with the vormstaf.
gui.guhs.bouwopdracht.wijs.twee: Close the menu and click two points with the vormstaf (first A, then B).
gui.guhs.bouwopdracht.wijs.uitleg: You need a vormstaf. You have 2 minutes.
gui.guhs.bouwopdracht.herbereken.uitleg: Moved the ghost? Then they work it out again at that spot.
gui.guhs.bouwopdracht.grootte.0: Grumpy family: they build it small.
gui.guhs.bouwopdracht.grootte.1: Content family: they build it normal.
gui.guhs.bouwopdracht.grootte.2: Happy family: they build it big and extra pretty!
gui.guhs.bouwopdracht.onderweg: On a work outing to the job: %s
gui.guhs.bouwopdracht.status.spook: Ghost ready: %s. Press Bouw! in the ghost.
gui.guhs.bouwopdracht.bank.nee: No Bank Guh (click the board with a Banksleutel).
gui.guhs.bouwopdracht.verblijf.uitleg: Puts a fitting home down as a ghost, with everything that makes this animal happy and a fence around it. The family helps build it.
gui.guhs.bouwopdracht.nee.al_bezig: This family is already on a job. One job per board, chonk!
gui.guhs.bouwopdracht.nee.geen_water: Nothing flows here, njeg. Let the digging crew dig a stream first.
gui.guhs.bouwopdracht.nee.te_breed: That water is too wide to cross. Find a narrower bit.
gui.guhs.bouwopdracht.nee.geen_plek: There is no flat spot near here.
gui.guhs.bouwopdracht.nee.te_scheef: It's too uneven here. Let an elephant stamp it flat first.
gui.guhs.bouwopdracht.nee.geen_heuvel: There's no hill here to dig into.
gui.guhs.bouwopdracht.nee.geen_omgevalle: There are no fallen trees here.
gui.guhs.bouwopdracht.nee.al_vlak: It's nice and flat here already!
gui.guhs.bouwopdracht.nee.geen_tweede_bo: There's no second tree 5 to 20 blocks away.
gui.guhs.bouwopdracht.nee.wijs_aan: Point out a spot yourself with the vormstaf.
gui.guhs.bouwopdracht.nee.wijs_aan_twee: Point out two points yourself with the vormstaf.
gui.guhs.bouwopdracht.nee.niets_te_doen: Nothing left to do there: it's done already!
gui.guhs.bouwopdracht.nee.geen_gras: There's no grass here to plant on.
gui.guhs.bouwopdracht.nee.te_ver: Too far away: a job may be up to 48 blocks from the board.
gui.guhs.bouwopdracht.nee.twee_kisten: Point out two chests (first the one to take from, then the one to put into).
gui.guhs.bouwopdracht.nee.andere_helper: Another family is already working there. One helper at a time!
gui.guhs.bouwopdracht.nee.te_klein: That wall is too small for wood carving.
gui.guhs.bouwopdracht.nee.geen_kamer: That's not a room: point out the floor of a space with walls and a ceiling.
gui.guhs.bouwopdracht.nee.geen_muur: Point out a wall with air in front of it.
gui.guhs.bouwopdracht.nee.geen_tunnel: Point out a tunnel, cave or cellar (underground).
gui.guhs.bouwopdracht.nee.geen_soort: This animal doesn't know what it needs.
gui.guhs.bouwopdracht.uitleg.dam: The beavers find the narrowest spot of a stream, build a dam there and the water behind it rises into a beaver pond.
gui.guhs.bouwopdracht.uitleg.burcht: A beaver lodge in the water: a heap of sticks and mud with a dry room and a front door under water.
gui.guhs.bouwopdracht.uitleg.brug: A wooden bridge over the narrowest bit of water, with railings.
gui.guhs.bouwopdracht.uitleg.steiger: A jetty from the shore into the water, with little lanterns at the end.
gui.guhs.bouwopdracht.uitleg.vlonder: A boardwalk along the shore, above the water.
gui.guhs.bouwopdracht.uitleg.kappen: The beavers gnaw the trees down. Cosy little stumps stay behind.
gui.guhs.bouwopdracht.uitleg.kelder: A cellar underground, with a ladder down and a little light.
gui.guhs.bouwopdracht.uitleg.tunnel: A tunnel into the hill, with wooden beams and lanterns.
gui.guhs.bouwopdracht.uitleg.vijver: A pond, level with the ground, with water lilies.
gui.guhs.bouwopdracht.uitleg.holletjesne: A burrow network: little rooms underground with tunnels and two exits.
gui.guhs.bouwopdracht.uitleg.beekje: A little stream running down the hill, with a gravel bed.
gui.guhs.bouwopdracht.uitleg.sjouwen: The elephant carries for a Bouwkeet nearby: that project goes faster.
gui.guhs.bouwopdracht.uitleg.opruimen: The elephant clears away fallen trees.
gui.guhs.bouwopdracht.uitleg.stampen: The elephant stamps the ground flat.
gui.guhs.bouwopdracht.uitleg.slopen: The demolition crew takes a building or a boulder away. Point it out with the vormstaf.
gui.guhs.bouwopdracht.uitleg.zebrapad: The herd walks a path from the board to a spot, over the terrain.
gui.guhs.bouwopdracht.uitleg.planten: Plant trees, bushes, flowers or an orchard.
gui.guhs.bouwopdracht.uitleg.boomhut: A treehouse in a tree, with a ladder and a little roof.
gui.guhs.bouwopdracht.uitleg.touwbrug: A rope bridge between two trees.
gui.guhs.bouwopdracht.uitleg.hangbrug: A suspension bridge that sags a little in the middle.
gui.guhs.bouwopdracht.uitleg.iglo: An igloo with an ice window and a little entrance tunnel.
gui.guhs.bouwopdracht.uitleg.ijsglijbaan: An ice slide with a ladder up.
gui.guhs.bouwopdracht.uitleg.ijssculptuu: An ice sculpture of a guh!
gui.guhs.bouwopdracht.uitleg.ijsvloer: The water freezes into an ice floor.
gui.guhs.bouwopdracht.uitleg.badje: A warm bath with a little campfire next to it.
gui.guhs.bouwopdracht.uitleg.hottub: A round hot tub with a stone rim.
gui.guhs.bouwopdracht.uitleg.stapstenen: Stepping stones to cross the water.
gui.guhs.bouwopdracht.uitleg.modderglijb: A mud slide into the water. Wheee!
gui.guhs.bouwopdracht.uitleg.oever: Pink flowers, reed and water lilies along the shore.
gui.guhs.bouwopdracht.uitleg.sneeuwschui: The mammoth pushes the snow away, into little heaps at the edge.
gui.guhs.bouwopdracht.uitleg.sneeuwlaag: The mammoth lays a layer of snow.
gui.guhs.bouwopdracht.uitleg.buideltrans: The kangaroo hops things from one chest to another.
gui.guhs.bouwopdracht.uitleg.houtsnijwer: The woodpecker taps a pattern into a wooden wall.
gui.guhs.bouwopdracht.uitleg.inrichten: The octopus furnishes a room. Point out the floor.
gui.guhs.bouwopdracht.uitleg.slingers: The gibbon hangs garlands between two points.
gui.guhs.bouwopdracht.uitleg.gevel: The gecko livens up a facade: ivy and flower pots under the windows.
gui.guhs.bouwopdracht.uitleg.licht: The glow-worms light up a tunnel, cave or cellar with a soft glow.
gui.guhs.bouwopdracht.uitleg.decoreren: The bowerbird decorates a spot in a colour theme.
